Bismarck’s Reich had two components. It was National-Liberal. The national element was the political component. The liberal element was the economic component.

After the defeat of 1918, these two components came apart, producing a kind of nuclear fission. That was the critical period of the Weimar Constitution, 1919–1933. In 1933, the national element was unleashed as an independent force and grew far beyond all proportion until it finally burst apart in 1944/45.
